definitions: A device with two interlocking parts, typically used for fastening a belt, bracelet, or necklace.
A firm hold or grip with the hand or arms.
A small bar or hook that slides into a corresponding loop or eye, used to fasten a piece of jewellery or a garment.
examples: The clasp on her necklace broke.
He released his clasp on her arm.
The handbag had a decorative clasp.
